lots.guide_summary: Close comparables only (teak-framed Danish-style sets of 6 at Gowans): $210 to $610 hammer, both SOLD. Wider category: unattributed sets of 6 at Gowans sold $80 to $170, a named Kinross set $490. Asking prices for named Parker sets at dealers $600 to $1,990 (asking only, restored or named maker, not comparable). No unsold evidence. All AUD, no conversion.
lots.working: Keep: lowest close SOLD = $210 (Gowans lot 405150, teak-framed set of 6, some damage). 210 / 1.198 = 175.3, round down to $175 hammer ($209.65 all-in). Flip: likely resale about $300 (conservative, between the two close Gowans hammers of $210 and $610, local Facebook Marketplace sale, no selling fee, pickup only so no outbound postage). 300 / 2.396 = 125.2, round down to $125. Inbound freight $0 (pickup from Moonah). Note these are close, not identical, comparables: no maker is identified on lot 721.
lots.confidence_reason: Clear identification of type and construction from both photos, and two close SOLD Gowans results with pages and photos checked, but no maker mark seen and condition of frames and joints not visible in detail.
lots.dropped_entries: Gumtree Mosman $965 and Gumtree Newport $1,600: snippet only, generic search-results URL, private asking, never verified; dropped (leads only). Arthur Johnson & Sons (UK) GBP 85 Nathan set, 25 May 2024: lot page opened but no price shown, older than 24 months, overseas, and the GBP 1 = AUD 2.00 rate was assumed; dropped. Reclassified: 431220 ($80), 433225 ($140), 428510 ($170) downgraded from close to category guide after viewing photos (fully upholstered or blonde beech low-back, not teak-framed high-back); 428113 ($610) upgraded to close (teak-framed Danish-style). So Last Century $1,900 kept as ASKING with page text verified.
lots.key_photo_findings: Two photos. All six chairs alike, high backs with curved top rail, exposed frame wrapping the upholstered back panel, tapered square legs, side rails visible. Fabric is a dated cream and mauve abstract print, looks clean with no obvious tears or stains at this resolution. No maker label or stamp visible (undersides not photographed). Frames appear sound; finish looks a little dry.
lots.condition: Appears good used condition from photos; fabric clean but dated (many buyers will reupholster). Joints, glue blocks and underside labels not shown.
lots.question_for_gowans: Is there any maker label, stamp or sticker under the seats or on the back rails (for example Parker, Chiswell, Elite, Moran or a Danish import label)? Are all six frames firm with no loose joints or cracks, and is the fabric free of stains or tears? Is the timber solid teak?

No edition number visible; any paper margin is hidden by the white mount. Heavy reflections in the glass. Frame black, looks sound.
lots.condition: Frame and glass appear intact in the photo; paper condition, fading and any foxing cannot be judged through the reflections.
lots.question_for_gowans: Is this a digital print or giclee, or a screenprint? Is there a pencil signature or edition number under the mount, or any gallery or framer's label on the back? What are the frame dimensions?
